from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak
import numpy as np

class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor using PocketCoffea"""
    
    def object_preselection(self, event):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        event["MuonGood"] = event.Muon[
            (event.Muon.pt > 15) & 
            (np.abs(event.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        return event
    
    def count_objects(self, event):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        event["n_muons"] = ak.count(event.MuonGood, axis=1)
        return event

from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak
import numpy as np

class DimuonAnalyzer(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor using PocketCoffea"""
    
    def object_preselection(self, event):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        event["MuonGood"] = event.Muon[
            (event.Muon.pt > 15) & 
            (np.abs(event.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        return event
    
    def count_objects(self, event):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        event["n_muons"] = ak.count(event.MuonGood, axis=1)
        return event
